program.name: Kick & Stretch
program.subject: Fighter
program.blurb: Kickboxing bouts, then a flexibility flow for higher, easier kicks.
program.about: Kickboxing bouts, then the flexibility that makes kicks higher and easier. Kick days drill teeps, roundhouses and side kicks, then open the hips and hamstrings; combination days mix punches and kicks, then work the spine and hip flexors. The stretches are held on the clock and the voice walks you through. Levels II and III bring longer combinations and longer holds.
